name: Speech resin
body:
Source Ultimate Intrigue pg. 236
Price 410 gp; Weight —
Category Alchemical Tools
Description
Chewing this gummy substance grants you 1d4 uses of alchemical inspiration that can be used only on Charisma-based skill checks. This benefit lasts for 1 hour, during which you must roll all Wisdom-based skill checks twice and take the worse result.
Construction
Craft (Alchemy) DC 25
